subject: general
question: The parasitic mode of nutrition is used by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**tape-worms.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Tapeworms show the **parasitic mode of nutrition.**
 
• Tapeworm is a parasite which survives in the** intestine of humans.**
 
• It feeds on the** food eaten and digested **by humans.
 
• They depend on their host for survival and the **host supplies nutrition and protection.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06b9768f253a42571888cb01e6b0d5fc21e60b2e4104ce110413aa209175b846.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Manner of nutrition in** yeast, mushroom and bread-mould** is** saprophytic.**
 
• They obtain energy from **expired and rotting organic matter.**
 
• **Mushrooms** have a saprophytic system of nutrition.​
